checks.outcome: For F(E)=X×πE, preservation of the terminal object forces X/π to be a singleton, hence X nonempty and transitive. For g≠1, the equalizer of the equivariant maps id and right multiplication by g on the left regular π-set is empty; preservation of this equalizer forces the right g-action on X to have no fixed point. Thus X is free and transitive. Conversely a chosen point in a right torsor identifies the underlying-set functor X×π− with the forgetful functor, so it preserves finite limits; limits of π′-sets are computed on underlying sets. This checks the displayed criterion in its stated set-action setting.
